title: Angle of Elevation and Depression — Some Applications of Trigonometry
hook: Let's explore Angle of Elevation and Depression from the chapter on Some Applications of Trigonometry. This is an important concept in NCERT Class 10 Mathematics that builds your foundation for higher studies!
explanation:
Angle of Elevation and Depression Angle of elevation is measured upward from the horizontal line of sight. Angle of depression is measured downward. Both use the same trigonometric ratios. Key Ideas to Master:
💡 Angle of elevation: looking UP from horizontal → angle above horizontal
💡 Angle of depression: looking DOWN from horizontal → angle below horizontal
💡 Angle of elevation from A = Angle of depression from B (alternate interior angles)
💡 Always draw a right triangle with the height as one side
